title: A window count under an explicit late-event policy
method: Synthetic one-minute window has 100 eventual events:90 before initial publication,8 within the correction interval,2 after the cutoff. Live counts become 90 then 98; offline full-fixture reconciliation yields 100. No observed completeness claim; cutoff policy controls treatment.
alt: A window count under an explicit late-event policy. Initial publication: 90 events; Live correction: 98 events; Full reconciliation: 100 events. Illustrative values.
